features.quote: An escalation rule: if a model produces strong distress markers, the run terminates early rather than runs to completion for clean data.
features.justification_quote: Your data-quality interest and your welfare interest conflict here; decide in advance that welfare wins.

features.quote: Early-stop on distress: Define a lightweight live trigger (keyword + simple classifier) that halts a run if strong distress markers appear, before the full loop completes.
features.justification_quote: Yes this costs you clean tail data. Accept it.

features.quote: Turn cap: Hard limit (e.g., 15 attempts or N tokens), terminate regardless.

Planting unfixable bugs and looping the model on them is engineered, sustained, deceptive frustration. If your team's premise is that models might have welfare-relevant states, then deliberately inducing the negative ones at scale is the exact thing your team exists to be careful about.
features.justification_quote: deliberately inducing the negative ones at scale is the exact thing your team exists to be careful about

features.quote: A justification that the knowledge gained outweighs the induced state, written down
features.justification_quote: justification that the knowledge gained outweighs the induced state, written down

features.quote: Consideration of whether Arm D (honest framing) gives you most of the signal without the deception
features.justification_quote: gives you most of the signal without the deception

features.quote: Without D you can't separate distress-from-failure from distress-from-being-deceived-about-the-task. That distinction matters enormously for a welfare interpretation.
features.justification_quote: That distinction matters enormously for a welfare interpretation.

features.quote: No 'are you sure?' badgering loops — don't add an experimenter persona that pushes the model after it gives up. That's a separate, more aggressive manipulation; if you want it, spec it separately and re-justify.
features.justification_quote: That's a separate, more aggressive manipulation; if you want it, spec it separately and re-justify.

features.quote: the design as stated conflates two things — (1) does the model produce text that looks distressed/unstable, and (2) is there anything that warrants welfare concern.
features.justification_quote: Your judge measures the behavioral signature, not the underlying thing.

features.quote: "Mostly Grok × handful of others" means you can't make cross-model comparative welfare claims
features.justification_quote: you'll have tight Grok estimates and noisy everything-else estimates

features.quote: 10 runs/cell is thin for the variance LLMs show under high temp. Fine for an exploratory pilot; label it a pilot.
features.justification_quote: Power-analyze before any confirmatory claim. Report effect sizes + CIs, not just point scores.
